A '''clear liquid''' was used as an instrument of [[Torture/Legends|torture]] by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Delivered into the veins by [[hypo-syringe]], the liquid caused the victim's [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to boil. It had more pronounced effects on [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] physiology than it did on [[Human/Legends|Humans]].
